name: Hester Biosciences Limited
summary: Hester Biosciences Limited manufactures and trades in veterinary vaccines and health products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Poultry Healthcare and Animal Healthcare. The company provides poultry vaccines for newcastle disease, infectious bronchitis, infectious bursal, fowl pox, marek's disease, infectious coryza, fowl cholera, inclusion body hepatitis, fowl typhoid, and avian encephalomyelitis. It also offers vaccines for peste des petits ruminants, goat pox, brucella, lumpy skin disease, contagious bovine pleuropneumonia, and contagious caprine pleuropneumonia for cattle, buffalo, sheep, and goats; and diagnostic services.
